review_repairs_applied.derivation_code_digest_unreproducible: derivation_code_sha256 was a disk-byte digest of a tracked file, so no fresh checkout could reproduce it under core.autocrlf; it matched only because the freeze ran against a copy written with LF endings. It is now the Git blob digest, supplied by the caller and validated as 64 hex characters, with the byte semantics recorded, and the archived code member carries those exact blob bytes so it reproduces on any platform.
review_repairs_applied.donor_set_digest_non_injective: The digest joined identities with a pipe and validated them only for non-blankness and uniqueness, so a one-element set containing 'a|b' and a two-element set containing 'a' and 'b' produced identical pre-hash bytes and the same digest. Reproduced exactly. Now length-prefixed with explicit cardinality and a V2 domain tag. The membership set digest therefore moved from f8983834... to bde1f1ed50739f44cd64a1a952d7a367dc5c032f8eb84aa38c7db604314297a1; the 46-donor set itself is unchanged.
review_repairs_applied.exact_package_contents: An unmanifested extra file was ignored; the directory must now hold exactly the registry, metadata, manifest and root file.
review_repairs_applied.external_root_verification: The loader compared the manifest only with the root stored beside it, so a wholesale self-consistent replacement validated. Both expected roots are now required keyword arguments.
review_repairs_applied.frozen_code_drift_undetected: Nothing checked that the module on the branch was still the code that produced the frozen authority. A cosmetic vocabulary pass moved its blob while the metadata named the old digest, and the suite was silent. A regression now compares the module blob at HEAD against the recorded digest, so any edit here requires a re-freeze.
review_repairs_applied.index_mode_fail_open: authority_path_dirty compared only the index object id, so a staged --chmod flip preserved the blob and evaded the authority gate whenever the path was a declared modification. The bound mode is now passed in and compared.
review_repairs_applied.loader_member_toctou: The loader authenticated each member by path and then reopened the metadata and registry to parse them. A same-length metadata forgery injected in that interval was returned with membership_donor_set_sha256 of all zeros while both external roots still reported correct. Members are now read once into memory; lengths, digests and both roots are computed from those captured bytes and parsing happens from the same buffers, so no member is reopened after authentication. Symlinks, reparse points, subdirectories and unmanifested extras are refused. The regression asserts the metadata is opened exactly once, because a second open is the attack surface.
review_repairs_applied.membership_set_digest: membership_donor_count alone did not identify a set. With every donor available any 46 of 84 satisfied the same counts, so a canonical set digest is now bound.
review_repairs_applied.review_package_layout: The V1 archive stored tests at tests/ and code at code/, but the tests resolve the module through parents[2]/scripts/v4, so the archive could not run its own tests as extracted. V3 uses repository-relative paths and carries RUN_REVIEW.md; verified by extracting to a clean directory and running 26 passed from there.
review_repairs_applied.stale_one_root_language: Module docstring and test names still described a single package root as value-invariant; corrected to the two-root contract.
review_repairs_applied.toctou: The source was hashed by path and then reopened, so the recorded digest could describe one revision while availability was derived from another, and source_bytes came from a still later stat. The bytes are now read once, those exact bytes are authenticated, parsing happens from memory, and source_bytes is their length.
review_repairs_applied.toctou_regression_strength: The first TOCTOU test contained an `assert ... or True`, which proves nothing, and never ran the full builder while the backing file changed. It now wraps read_authenticated_source so it authenticates bytes A, replaces the file with materially different bytes B, and returns A; the registry, source digest and source_bytes must all derive from A.
review_repairs_applied.writer_byte_binding: Found by the peer, not by me: the writer wrote each member and then reopened the path to hash it, so a same-length substitution in that interval became the bytes the manifest recorded while the builder still returned the original in-memory metadata. The manifest is now derived from the exact in-memory payloads before anything is written, so a write-time substitution makes the directory fail verification instead of redefining the authority. This was the writer-side twin of the reader-side interval I had already closed, and I had not looked for it.

reported_not_resolved.derivation_ignores_its_own_read_plan: The walk uses frozen membership order, which is almost fully interleaved at 19953 contiguous runs across 20804 rows. Under the 48-entry cache it loaded 3126 blocks and read 18.35 GB, against 7.35 GB block-major and 114.84 GB uncached. Efficiency only: per-row work is order-independent and the donor reduction uses math.fsum, which is exactly rounded, so a block-major walk would produce identical roots.
reported_not_resolved.frozen_role_modules_not_equivalent: split_v2.generate ranks every support donor while build_role_authority ranks only the metadata-complete ones, so they disagree whenever an ineligible donor ranks inside the top 18. Values are correct and CRLF-safe; only the method claim is false. The eligible-donor lane now states it accurately; the other seven are left alone because correcting them moves package roots already cited in DEC-024, including B2. Scoped to derivation_code_byte_semantics in the authority packages; work_checkpoint's git-blob byte authority is accurate.

promotion_successor.blocking_design_finding: V20 cannot be promoted by flipping a flag. Its verifiers raise unless real_execution_ready is not False, so they accept only False, while its production entrypoints raise unless it is not True, so they proceed only on True. The two are mutually exclusive by construction, which is what makes V20 permanently unready. A promotion successor therefore needs its own authority schema, verifier and entrypoint triple wrapping accepted V20, and may not reuse V20's verifier.

r5_boundary_repair.finding: _ConstructionGuard being a module-level Python class is not a security or capability boundary; any same-process caller can import and instantiate it. The R5 fix had replaced one importable sentinel with another and called it closed.
r5_boundary_repair.repair: The boundary is removed rather than defended. The only public proof is prove_population_from_source_path, which takes a filesystem path and owns opening, hashing, consumption and closing. The handle-accepting row proof is private and fixture-only, and the old public name raises STOP_T0_RAW_SOURCE_PUBLIC_PROOF_DOES_NOT_ACCEPT_A_HANDLE. The guard is retained as defence in depth and documented as not a capability. The protection that does hold is that AuthenticatedSource re-derives its digest from the bytes, so a handle built around another file cannot claim the frozen identity even by a caller who imports the guard.

r5_repairs.2_population_raw_source_authority: prove_population_from_source_path proves EVERY accepted logical row from real bytes and binds the exact row cardinality, the logical root and the source digest. assert_population_authority_covers_logical refuses a proof set that is short, that covers other rows, or whose root does not verify three ways. Technical completeness consumes it and takes Q_DEPTH from the PROVEN library rather than the stored one, because recomputing the logical root shows the value is bound, not that it came out of the H5 row.
r5_repairs.3_token_demoted: The module-level sentinel was an importable attribute, so it was never a capability. It is now explicitly refused, the real construction guard is created inside the private opener and is unreachable as a module attribute, and AuthenticatedSource re-derives the digest from the bytes on the way in, so even a caller reaching the constructor cannot claim a digest the file does not have. prove_population_from_source_path accepts a path and no caller-built handle at all.
r5_repairs.4_one_descriptor: The opener hashes and consumes ONE open file object: _digest_fileobj hashes the stream and rewinds it, and that same object is handed to h5py.File. The previous version hashed one open of the pathname and then reopened the pathname, which left a window in which the two opens could describe different bytes.
r5_repairs.5_projection_mandatory: expected_projection_positions defaults to 35,076 in both the derivation and the production entrypoint. A smaller projection is a fixture and must say so explicitly.
r5_repairs.6_no_fabricated_physical_parent: The fallback that recorded the logical root under the name physical_read_plan_root_sha256 is gone. A physical read plan is required and verified stored == recomputed == externally expected, because it is what determines which counts payloads are read.
r5_repairs.7_preflight_root_binds_decisions: preflight_root binds every records root present on the stage, the donor-bound flag, the residual degrees of freedom, the tail inference n and the LOODO fold ranks. Previously it hashed only stage names and rank results, so different donor-bound designs with identical ranks collided.
r5_repairs.8_geometry_mandatory: Technical completeness requires the authenticated closure and passes its bound rows and nnz into the payload verifier on the production path, so the declaration and the payload are obligatorily reconciled rather than through optional arguments a caller could omit.

three_roots.population_closure_root: operator, matrix, every block scanned, rows scanned and per-cell block plus row location. The scan covers every block and does not stop once every target has been seen, because a duplicate can appear in a later block.

self_audit_20260908.finding_1: authority_path_dirty measured dirtiness with `git status` against current HEAD rather than the checkpoint-bound commit. After a later commit replaced a declared authority the worktree was clean against the new HEAD, so a completely different file could stand in for the authority with no authority-level complaint. Worse, a test had ratified this as expected behaviour. Dirtiness is now the comparison of the bound tree entry object id against `git hash-object --path`, which applies the same clean filter a commit would, so it is exact on a CRLF checkout with no line-ending handling in Python and touches neither the index nor the object store.

t0_v20_materialization_lane.source_library_rule: Phase2 constructs source_library as an integer sum of the FULL raw source row, computed BEFORE source-to-address projection. Bind it as an exact positive integer. Never recompute it from the stored 41,238-address row or from the 35,076-address T0 projection; neither sum is required to equal it.

conjuncts: donor belongs to the accepted op31 candidate donor universe
donor has at least one authenticated accepted cell
the donor's accepted cells close correctly through the authenticated B2 substrate
the required raw-count and source_library information is valid enough to compute the frozen technical summaries
Q_DETECT(donor) is computable, finite, and within its lawful range
technical_completeness_specification.fail_closed_rule: technical_complete is evaluated ONLY on a lawfully authenticated substrate. A wrong source digest, a missing accepted membership cell, a donor/cell identity mismatch, a wrong source row, a wrong materialized row, a counts digest failure or a manifest inconsistency are B2 STOPs. They are never reasons to mark a donor technically incomplete. The predicate answers 'are the required technical summaries defined?', not 'did provenance validation fail?'.
technical_completeness_specification.shortfall_rule: If the frozen eligible universe falls below 18 CONFIRMATION + 18 minimum DISCOVERY donors, raise STOP_T0_DESIGN_NOT_EXECUTABLE_UNDER_FROZEN_ELIGIBILITY. Do not relax eligibility, do not introduce a cutoff, and do not alter the split.
technical_completeness_specification.single_sex_rule: If the actual deterministic confirmation set is single-sex, nuisance_design refuses it and the role authority must fail loudly. This is a design failure, not a biological NOT_MEASURABLE, and the split must not be altered to rescue it.
technical_completeness_specification.v18_interpretation: Technical completeness is pathology-blind pre-outcome eligibility metadata derived deterministically from authenticated expression technical summaries. 'Metadata-only' in V18 SS201 means no pathology magnitude and no discovery/confirmation outcome information is used; it does not mean the flag must originate as a literal column in a source metadata file.
